application_text: 现有代码包含学生对话和报告入口、外部模型适配、可选知识检索、规则统计以及教师预警审核与跟进记录，可作为后续试点的工程基础；代码盘点不代表目标环境已启用模型或通过专业评测。现有风险标签和分值属于线索或规则输出，不是诊断概率。项目拟先固定知识资料与单一模型开展受控摘要验证，保留所有成功、失败和超时请求，由专业人员按预先制定的量规独立复核后，再决定是否扩展。
recommended_application_additions: Separate existing implementation from proposed work and runtime configuration.
Describe AI as an assistant for summarization, explanation and navigation, with staff responsible for communication and action.
State that fixed-rule scores, keyword signals and model confidence values are not calibrated diagnostic probabilities.
For an initial trial, pin model, prompt, parameters, knowledge version and synthetic case set; count failures/timeouts in the evaluation denominator and use independent human ratings.
Leave provider, professional reviewers, school owner, staffing/SLA, sample/recruitment, privacy retention, success threshold, budget and schedule as unconfirmed inputs until supplied.
